canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Ashland Rim's chapter of the book of lore, its lines the game's; the Ash-Walkers, the Weave-Eaters and their salt (book1 ch.20) and the Cult of Ash (book1 ch.10) are CANON, as each line says.

entries.subject: Ash-Walker enclave
entries.more: The Walkers chalk their war on slates by the harpoon rack: every Eater bound, every line of salt laid, every name lost. The line holds, the last slate says, because they walk it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Ash-Walkers and their salt against the Weave-Eaters are CANON (book1 ch.20); the slates are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Tear-marked shrine
entries.more: The bone-masks' litany says the grey is the truth coming home and the Weave was a lie told by the Makers. They kneel in the ash because the ash is honest.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash and its cry are CANON (book1 ch.10); this litany is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Cinderfold
entries.more: Somebody stood a doorstone on end with a child's heights cut up its edge, a tick a year. The ticks stop the year the grey came through. The houses stayed.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the hamlet and its doorstone. The Wasting unmaking rather than destroying is CANON (book1 ch.20).

entries.subject: Wain's Rest
entries.more: The waybook lists the wains as they came: six west with salt, then four, then two, then a page of nothing. The carters said the pans were crusting grey at the far edge.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Ash Pit
entries.more: The Deacon's tally of what was given to the fire: ridge salt that would not burn, an old wain-horse, the last rafters of the waystation.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash is CANON (book1 ch.10); the Deacon and his tally are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Silent Statue
entries.more: Grohl has stood three watches at the stone and says it does not move. The ash at its feet is further from it every dawn.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Statues, faceless monoliths in the Wasting, are CANON (world_bible.md); Grohl's watch is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Last Orchard
entries.more: The orchard-keeper buried his wife under the last tree that bore and cut her stone himself, the letters going deeper as he went. Then he walked into the grey.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Wasting
entries.more: The Walkers do not throw their salt. They walk it, one hand low, the grains falling in a thread, singing as they go, and the grey stops where they stop.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Ash-Walkers binding with Salt of the First Sea and its chant are CANON (book1 ch.20); how it is walked is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Mother Vane
entries.more: The Salt-Speaker taught you the chant over the salt, and to say it loud: the salt doesn't hear you, she says. You hear you.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the chant is CANON (book1 ch.20); Mother Vane's teaching is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Weave-Eater
entries.line: Things that feed on the Weave at the grey's edge, soft and many-mouthed. Salt binds them; steel only annoys them.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Weave-Eaters and the Ash-Walkers' salt are CANON (book1 ch.20); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Ash hound
entries.line: Hounds gone grey to the bone, hunting the plain in packs. They don't bark. They don't need to.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Old Cinder-Jaw
entries.line: The oldest of the ash hounds, with a jaw like a coal-shovel. He hunts the old west road alone.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Bone-masked cultist
entries.line: The Cult of Ash: they wear the bone, mark the tear, and kneel in the grey because it is honest.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash and its bone masks are CANON (book1 ch.10); these are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Brood Weave-Eater
entries.line: A brood-mother at the grey's edge, where the Eaters grow fat. Bind her and the brood goes hungry.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Weave-Eaters are CANON (book1 ch.20); the brood is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Hollow Man
entries.line: The emptied dead of the hamlet the grey went through. They still walk its lanes as if they had somewhere to be.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Hollow Men are a CANON creature (book1 ch.4); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Ash-Deacon
entries.line: The cult's deacon at the pit, who keeps the tally of what is given to the fire.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash is CANON (book1 ch.10); the Deacon is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Sandthrone salt-raider
entries.line: Sandthrone riders who raid the salt road west, because this close to the grey salt is worth more than silver.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Sandthrone mercenary company is CANON (world_bible.md); these men are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Pale shadow
entries.line: A shadow by the standing stones where nothing casts it. Cold, and counting.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL foreshadowing within CANON: the Pale Things as cosmic auditors are CANON (world_bible.md); this one is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: node.cinder
entries.line: Cinder ore: black, glassy seams the grey has baked into the Ridge's flank. It rings like a bell under the pick, which the Walkers take for a good sign.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: node.snag
entries.line: Ash-snags: dead trunks gone half to stone, still good timber inside. The Walkers burn them; the cult will not.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: node.cinder_thistle
entries.line: A grey thistle that grows only on ground the grey has touched and left. Its sting is dull and lasts a day.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: herb.last_light
entries.line: A pale flower that pushes up through the ash where nothing else will. The Walkers say it grows where something refused to be unmade.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.
